title: Onboard contrastive encoder + reranker; publish deterministic performance profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Scope: Add a new contrastive encoder (bi-encoder) + lightweight cross-encoder reranker to the model catalog, pin a deterministic version set for Dedicated and Hosted lanes, and publish reproducible performance profiles for embeddings and reranking across common hardware (A100/RTX6000). Goals: 1) Certify compatibility with profile manifest format, 2) Produce latency/cost/quality matrices for pinned variants (fp16, int8 QAT/ptq), 3) Provide a canary rollout plan and automated gating for profile publish.

Acceptance criteria:
- Model artifacts uploaded and registered in catalog with pinned version tags (eg. v1.2.0-pinned).
- Performance profile JSONs generated by the benchmark harness, including P50/P95 latency, throughput, memory, precision@1/10, MRR, embedding cosine stability metrics, and quantization deltas.
- Canary pipeline that runs sampling evals on production traffic shadow for 24h and asserts no regression >2% in precision@10 and no latency P95 bump >10%.
- Documentation: onboarding runbook + links to PRD and design docs.
- Publishing step idempotent: profile publish can be re-run without changing pinned model unless explicitly flagged.

Out of scope: re-training or architecture changes to the models, UI changes to Console (Console integration tracked in PM follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts registered and pinned with clear tags
Profile JSONs with required metrics published to artifact store
Canary pipeline gated with automated rollback triggers
Runbook for re-certifying and unpinning published
Benchmarks produced across A100 and RTX6000 hardware

notes: Trade-offs considered: aggressive int8 quantization reduces cost but increases embedding drift; we add 'quant_delta' fields so Console can show estimated quality vs. cost.
Decision: publish pinned versions for Hosted and Dedicated lanes; Private deployments will default to unpinned artifacts but can opt into pinned via manifest flag.
Follow-up: PM to create Console ticket to expose 'pinned' badge and downgrade guidance (PM-41234).
implementation_steps: 1) Validate model artifact and reproducible seed for embeddings
2) Run baseline eval on eval-suite (precision@1/10, MRR, recall@1..100)
3) Run latency and memory profiles across target hardware (A100, RTX6000)
4) Generate profile JSON and upload to artifact store with pinned tag
5) Create canary job that shadows subset of live traffic and compares metrics
6) Gate publish with automated checks and manual approval flow if thresholds exceed limits
risks: Quantization-induced embedding drift causing downstream reranker regressions
Insufficient sampling during canary leading to missed regressions
Cross-architecture performance variance not captured in single-run profiles
rollback_plan: Revert pinned model in catalog to previous pinned tag
Trigger emergency fallback routing to non-quantized variant for Dedicated customers
Open incident and run manual eval harness to triage quality delta (assign to ENG-SRE)
